name: HoloMart Saved Searches

provenance.label: SYNTHETIC / DEMO-ONLY
provenance.description: Authentication-independent design context authored locally for the Copilot-for-Product demo. It contains no external design URL or copyrighted card artwork.

viewportFrames.purpose: Marketplace hero, Saved Searches panel, filters, and three-column card catalog
Saved Searches above a wrapped toolbar and two-column catalog
Apply a saved search, compare price and condition, and recover stale criteria

components.nativeStartingPoint: buttons plus native dialog for create

rules: Market comparison is contextual, not a guarantee

contentSamples.localOnlyNote: Stored on this device only. Clearing site data removes this search.
contentSamples.zeroResults: No cards match this search. Review its filters or try another expansion.
contentSamples.storageError: Searches cannot be saved in this browser right now. You can continue shopping.
contentSamples.alertBoundary: Saving a search does not create a price alert.

interactionNotes: Applying a search replaces supported filters after validation.
Unavailable criteria are explained and never silently broadened.
Filter edits never overwrite a search without an explicit action.
Price-alert consent is separate from saving.
Escape dismisses transient surfaces without saving and restores focus.
Reduced-motion users receive equivalent state changes without animation.
handoffChecks: Keyboard-only create, apply, rename, delete, cart, and recovery
Screen-reader names for filters, listings, prices, sellers, and outcomes
Reflow at 320 CSS px and 400 percent zoom
Corrupt local data and unavailable storage
No telemetry payload contains search names, filter values, card identities, or prices
